title: [FEATURE]  configurable diff tool eg delta that displays function names and has syntax highlighting in term
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

Similarly to git I think it would be really cool if one could configure a diff tool that is being used by claude-code.
Colorized syntax and function name before every major chunk and more...


### Proposed Solution

Config setting to allow to set diff tool and/or a pager.
Ideally I'd like to use things like delta: https://github.com/dandavison/delta


### Alternative Solutions

Better syntax highlighting in diffs and class/function name before every major chunk.

### Priority

Medium - Would be very helpful

### Feature Category

Developer tools/SDK

### Use Case Example

Any code change that I review presents me a diff but 
but the format is different from what I used to from `git diff` and modern diff tools...


### Additional Context

Please see tools like `delta`
author: pawciobiel

top_comments.author: pawciobiel
top_comments.body: The diff format has been improved in 2.1.20 and it is similar to delta now - but still, having it configurable would be very useful.

top_comments.author: rdeforest
top_comments.body: Previous requests have been closed automatically (and incorrectly). Can we get some kind of input from the team that will prevent this from being automatically closed for inactivity? This isn't a frivolous request, it's a request for feature parity with 40-year-old tools. I'm especially interested in ignoring whitespace changes in diffs, as I explained in #26670, which I have since closed in favor of this issue.
